- [ ] Both settings-only ROCKNIX/GAMES setup→scan→actual restore cases pass with exact selected archive/sentinel hashes; the remainder of the prepared installed/UI coverage runs and its failures, if any, stay distinct. All completion channels/seals and actual cleanup are retained.
